title: Crash site regraded for soybeans after the documentary

tellings.quote: I even made a remark to James. James went there shortly after that. They had done land grading literally.

I would add is I'd like an explanation for why for 26 years not a single straw was removed from that place. Then after 26 years James' documentary comes out and they go there and remove more than 30 meters of earth.
tellings.difference: Says more than 30 meters of earth was removed after 26 years of the site being left untouched, and does not mention soybeans.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Varginha crash site being dug up or regraded right after James Fox's documentary came out.

as_told.title: 30 meters of earth removed from crash site after James Fox documentary
as_told.place_text: Varginha crash site, Minas Gerais, Brazil

plain: A surgeon named Carlos de Souza, whose hospital he says operated on an alien, says that a reported crash site near Varginha, Brazil, sat untouched for 26 years. Then, right after a documentary by the filmmaker James Fox came out, someone came and graded the land, and in his words removed "more than 30 meters of earth." De Souza says Fox went to the site shortly afterwards and saw the regrading too. He wants someone to explain the timing, because if he is right, it would look like evidence was cleared away once people started paying attention.
